description: This is a pre-solicitation notice only; do not respond. The Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 10, requires Sterile Processing Service Water Testing Services for the Marion, Fort Wayne, and Jackie Walorski VA sites in Indiana. The Government intends to publish a 100% set-aside solicitation for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses on or about 11/25/2026. The solicitation will require the Contractor to furnish a quote providing all information requested in the Instructions to Offerors for Testing Laboratories and Services. The applicable NAICS Code is 541380 Testing Laboratories and Services with a size standard of $19.0 Million. Responses will be evaluated using comparative evaluation under FAR Parts 12 and 13; see solicitation for specific criteria. The resulting award will be a Base with Four Option Years, Firm Fixed Price contract. The closing date for receipt of offers is 12/10/2026 at 01:30 PM ET. All solicitation documents may be downloaded on the date of issuance through Contracting Opportunities via Sam.gov. Any amendments will be posted only on this website. The offeror is responsible for verifying the number of amendments issued. Offerors will have an opportunity to ask questions; details will be provided in the posted solicitation. After the questioning period closes, the Government will post responses to all questions on SAM.gov via a solicitation amendment within 3 business days. Phone calls will not be accepted. No site visit will be held. All offerors shall ensure registration is active, current, and accurate in SAM and includes NAICS code 541380 at the time of RFQ submission through award. Point of Contact: Eric Sweatt, Contract Specialist eric.sweatt@va.gov

title: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLICIT FROM A SINGLE SOURCE - Environmental Modeling Technical Support and EEMS Workshop Jacksonville Harbor Deepening Project
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLICIT A SINGLE SOURCE Environmental Modeling Technical Support and EEMS Workshop Jacksonville Harbor Deepening Project Notice ID: W912EP27Z1CYM NAICS: 541620 | PSC: B510 Proposed Source: DSI, LLC | UEI: MBMESK928KP3 Response Deadline: 10 December 2026 at 2:00PM EST The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Jacksonville District, intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price contract to DSI, LLC, on a single-source basis pursuant to Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) RFO 6.302-1 Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. This notice is issued to inform industry of the Government�s intent and to invite capability statements from firms that believe they can meet the requirement. This is not a request for quotations or proposals; no solicitation is available at this time. The requirement supports the Jacksonville Harbor Deepening Project�s environmental modeling activities, including assessment of salinity conditions in the Lower St. Johns River. The anticipated period of performance is 12 months. The required services include: � Preparation of customized workshop materials using the Government�s existing Jacksonville Harbor modeling files and relevant assessment scenarios; � One five-day, instructor-led, hands-on workshop for Government personnel covering the current EFDC+ Explorer Modeling System (EEMS), including EFDC+, EFDC+ Explorer, and Grid+, as applied to model configuration, calibration, validation, salinity analysis, scenario evaluation, post-processing, and interpretation of results; and � Up to 50 hours of follow-on remote technical assistance and troubleshooting relating to the existing EEMS modeling workflow. The acquisition does not include purchase of a perpetual EEMS software license or three years of software maintenance. DSI has represented that it developed and solely owns EEMS and maintains the source code for EFDC+, EFDC+ Explorer, and Grid+. DSI further represents that knowledge of current-release features, workflows, and model options depends on its recent software development work; that it provides customized training and technical support directly to U.S. clients; and that it has no licensed or authorized U.S. distributors, resellers, or agents. Based on the Government�s current technical assessment and market research, USACE anticipates that DSI is the only source reasonably available to provide the required current-release, developer-level training and technical assistance. The Government will consider information submitted in response to this notice before making a final acquisition decision. Interested responsible sources may submit a written capability statement demonstrating their ability to meet the complete requirement. Responses should specifically address current-release EEMS expertise; the ability to provide project-specific, hands-on training and follow-on troubleshooting for EFDC+, EFDC+ Explorer, and Grid+; access to the technical knowledge needed to support the current release without reliance on DSI; relevant experience; and the proposed approach and timeframe for performance. General environmental modeling experience or familiarity with earlier software versions, without evidence of capability to meet the stated current-release requirements, may not establish the ability to perform this requirement. Submit capability statements electronically to Ligaya Lowe, Contract Specialist, at ligaya.m.lowe@usace.army.mil, with a copy to Gerald Garvey, Contracting Officer, at gerald.l.garvey@usace.army.mil, no later than the response deadline stated above. Include the firm�s legal name, UEI, point of contact, and a concise description of relevant capabilities. Telephone responses will not be accepted. All timely responses will be reviewed solely to determine whether a competitive acquisition approach is appropriate. A determination not to complete this proposed acquisition, based on responses to this notice, is within the Government�s discretion and will be documented in the acquisition file. The Government is not obligated to issue a solicitation or reimburse any costs incurred in responding to this notice.

title: Great Lakes Restoration Initiative (GLRI) Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC)
description: ****Related Prior Solicitation Number W911XK26RA012 and W911XK27BA002**** The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is seeking contractors with the capability to provide environmental (mechanical) dredging and placement of contaminated sediment construction services in the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC) located in Riverview, Michigan. The project consist of work associated with the environmental maintenance dredging of the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel located in Riverview, Michigan. There are no options included with the solicitation. The channel is situated just south of Bridge Road and the Grosse Ile Toll Bridge. The primary goal of the project is to remove contaminated sediment from Sediment Management Area 1 (maximum 4 feet depth) and Area 2 (maxi-mum 25 feet depth). Approximately 28,100 cubic yards of material is planned to be re-moved using mechanical dredging means with transport and placement of the contaminated dredged material into Cell 5 of the Pointe Mouillee Confined Disposal Facility (CDF).

description: ****SOURCES SOUGHT FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY**** This announcement seeks information from industry which will be used for preliminary planning purposes. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this announcement. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS OR DRAWINGS ARE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. 1. AGENCY: United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA) 2. NAICS: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: Peru 4. ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. The Government�s final decision will be based on which strategy provides the best value and ensures a competitive environment among responsible and qualified contractors capable of meeting the demanding technical and logistical requirements of this project. 6. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The contemplated scope consists of complete Design-Build services�including geotechnical verification, site preparation, civil works, architectural and engineering design after award, structural construction, mechanical/electrical/plumbing (MEP), specialized HVAC/fire suppression, Defense Base Act (DBA) insurance coverage, and Furniture, Fixtures, & Equipment (FF&E). Facility / Scope Package Primary Function Key Technical Considerations Building 110 Spare Parts Warehouse Heavy-duty slab design, industrial racking integration, material handling flow, automated logistics staging. Building 115 Clothing & Gear Warehouse High-density pallet storage, humidity and climate control, inventory distribution bays. Building 112 Material Warehouse Bulk staging, overhead crane/hoist accommodations, heavy equipment ingress/egress ramps. Building 113 Customs Warehouse Secure bonded holding areas, host-nation customs inspection layout, physical security infrastructure. Building 114 Petroleum, Oil, and Lubricants (POL) Warehouse Secondary containment, explosion-proof electrical systems, specialized foam/water fire suppression, environmental drainage controls. Building 111 Medicine & Medical Supplies Warehouse Temperature/humidity-controlled storage (cold chain capability), pharmaceutical-grade clean finishings, backup power integration. Building 120 DIRNOTEMAT & Quality Control Building Administrative offices, testing and quality inspection laboratories, specialized testing benches, IT/telecom infrastructure. Site & Ancillary Works Infrastructure & Integration Site grading, structural fill, perimeter security, access roads, utility connections, complete FF&E packages, and host-nation compliant permitting. 7. SOURCES SOUGHT: The purpose of this source sought is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of contractors who have the capabilities to complete and perform contracts of this magnitude, and to address any questions, recommendations or concerns from Industry. The Government must ensure there is adequate competition among potential pool of responsible contractors. Prior Government contract work is not required for submitting a response under this Sources Sought announcement. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. 8. RESPONSES: The Capabilities Statement for this Sources Sought is not intended to be a Request for Proposal nor Invitation for Bid, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach. It is to request statements regarding the company's ability to demonstrate existing-or-developed expertise and experience in relation to the areas specified herein. Any commercial brochures or currently existing marketing material may also be submitted. This synopsis is for information and planning purposes only and is neither to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor will the Government pay for information solicited. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. Interested parties are requested to provide a capabilities statement addressing the following areas. Please specify if your company utilizes US Treasury-listed Surety Bonds, Peruvian Bank Letters of Guarantee (Carta Fianza), or Insurance-backed Guarantees (P�liza de Cauci�n). Relevant NAICS Codes Section 2: Interest and Experience in Peru Please confirm your company's interest in performing a design-build construction project of this magnitude and complexity in Lima, Peru. title: Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS)
description: The Sources Sought results will assist the Air Force in determining whether this solicitation will be unrestricted competition or a small business set-aside for C-Type contract to fulfill Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS) requirements. The Government is assessing the capability of companies that may possess the expertise to competently and competitively respond to the following requirements for the SCARS program: For the SCARS Program, the contractor shall possess the capabilities to fulfill 1) Security Operations Center (SOC) Operations, 2) Remote Assessment & Authorization, 3) Software Patching Baseline Integrity, 4) Maintain a SCARS Library, 5) Edge Virtualization & Modern Deployment on SCARS On-Premise Equipment (OPE), 6) Network Integration & Management, 7) Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), 8) Governance of Architecture Standards, 9) Enterprise Logistics & Fielding, 10) Data Requirements and 11) Security Requirements. The contract will commence CY2030 with an anticipated transition period up to six (6) months leading to full operational performance in CY 2031. The anticipated structure includes a 4-year base period with six 1-year option periods and an optional 6-month extension of services (RFO 52.217-8 Option to Extend Services). All projected dates and contact structures are notional and subject to change based on market research and acquisition strategy approval. The Government anticipates the use of: Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Contract Line-item Numbers (CLINs): Services Cost Reimbursable CLINs: Travel and studies/analysis tasks Other: CLIN may be of any type authorized Further questions may be e-mailed to Contracting Officer, Steve Godby, steven.godby@us.af.mil, Contracting Officer, Anne Torian, anne.torian@us.af.mil, and Program Manager, Daniel Douglass, daniel.douglass.2@us.af.mil. Responses must be submitted via email to Contracting Officer, Anne Torian, anne.torian@us.af.mil and Program Manager, Daniel Douglass, daniel.douglass.2@us.af.mil and are due NLT 3:00 PM EST, 10 December 2026. The Government may converse with respondents regarding this RFI. Such conversations are solely intended to clarify potential capability to perform the requirements.

title: Request for Information (RFI) for the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP)
description: FEMA is modernizing the National Flood Insurance Program to improve how it assesses and communicates flood risk, prices and delivers flood insurance, manages floodplains, and provides mitigation assistance. The goal is to help individuals, communities, states, and private-sector partners better understand and reduce flood risk while using policyholder and taxpayer funds efficiently. To support this effort, FEMA is integrating staff, initiatives, and support structures into a more unified NFIP operating model. The draft contract support model described in the RFI pursues those outcomes. Work will be grouped into several categories described in the RFI. Not all current NFIP support contracts will be recompeted immediately. This document also identifies selected support structures and contracts that are not currently within the scope of this RFI to provide a more complete picture of the NFIP support environment. Please see attached RFI for complete details.

description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) For Manufacturing/Procurement of Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly Noun NSN Part Number Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly 1650-01-187-9395HL 205-076-056-107 CAUTION: The Government is conducting market research to identify potential sources that possess the data, expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet qualification requirements to manufacture/procure the Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly, which is applicable to the TH-1H Helicopter. The Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly has an Acquisition Method Code (AMC)/ Acquisition Method Suffix Code (AMSC) code of 1/C.AMC 1: Suitable for competitive acquisition for the second or subsequent time. AMSC C: This part requires engineering source approval by the design control activity in order to maintain the quality of the part. Existing unique design capability, engineering skills, and manufacturing knowledge by the qualified source(s) require acquisition of the part from the approved source(s). The approved source(s) retain data rights, manufacturing knowledge, or technical data that are not economically available to the Government, and the data or knowledge is essential to maintaining the quality of the part. An alternate source must qualify in accordance with the design control activity's procedures, as approved by the cognizant Government engineering activity. The qualification procedures must be approved by the Government engineering activity having jurisdiction over the part in the intended application. See Attachment 1 (Source Qualification Statement). If one source is approved, AMCs 3, 4, or 5 are valid. If at least two sources are approved or if data is adequate for an alternate source to qualify in accordance with the design control activity's procedures, AMCs 1 or 2 are valid. The technical data required to manufacture the Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly is not owned by the Government. It has been determined to be uneconomical to buy the data or rights to the data. It is uneconomical to reverse engineer the part. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for the TH-1H Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly is Woodward HRT, Inc. (CAGE: 81873). The OEM for the TH-1H Helicopter is Bell Textron, Inc. (CAGE: 97499) The Government has determined that this assembly is a commercial item as defined in Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) 2.101. Commercial item descriptions, commercial vendor catalog or price lists or commercial manuals assigned a technical manual number apply. title: 155mm M231 and M232-Series Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) Propelling Charges
description: The U.S. Army Contracting Command � Rock Island at Picatinny (ACC-RI-PICA), Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey 07806-5000, on behalf of the Office of the Project Manager for Combat Ammunition Systems (PM CAS), intends to issue a competitive Request for Proposal (RFP) for the production of the M31 Series-Type Triple Base Propellant in support of the 155mm M231 and M232-Series Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) Propelling Charges. The Government intends to award up to two Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (ID/IQ) production type contract(s) with five (5) one-year ordering periods, dependent upon Formal Source Selection Evaluations (Best Value with Subjective Tradeoffs). The MACS Propelling Charge consists of two solid propellant charges, the M231 (Low-Zone) and the M232-series (High-Zone), and their associated packaging. The charge system provides a complete zoning solution for the 155mm artillery applications by using multiples of the basic modules through a "build-a-charge" incremental system. The M231 charges are used singly or in pairs for Low Zones (1 and 2) and the M232-series is used in groups of three, four, or five charges for High Zones (3, 4, and 5, respectively). The M31A2 triple base propellant is specifically used for the M232-series high-zone charge to enhance Warfighter capabilities by eliminating the need for �cleaner� rounds between top-zone firings, reducing gun wear, and extending gun-tube life. This propellant is essential for effective artillery operations, supporting both combat missions and training requirements. The M31 Series-Type Triple Base Propellant is a vital component of the 155mm M231 and M232-series propelling charges, which are used in howitzer artillery systems. The MACS offers significant improvements in operational flexibility, performance, logistics, and costs compared to the previous generation of bag propelling charges. The total maximum aggregate contract value will be $2,316,202,800.00 , to include all contract awards. Throughout the 5-year ordering period, PM CAS may order any quantity of M31 Series-Type Triple Base Propellant as long as the total value of the orders does not exceed the combined contract maximum. title: Industry Day - USACE SPK Geotechnical Drilling and Laboratory Services
description: Special Notice: Virtual Industry Day Event Schedule & Platform Date of Event: December 10, 2026 (Thursday) Time: 1:00 PM � 2:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) Location/Platform: Virtual via Microsoft Teams (see below for details) Purpose of Event The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Sacramento District (USACE-SPK) is pleased to announce a virtual Industry Day on December 10, 2026. The purpose of this session is to provide industry partners with a comprehensive overview of the upcoming Geotechnical Drilling Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The Government will present details regarding program requirements, anticipated geographic scope, proposed technical evaluation factors (such as specialized rig fleet inventory and AASHTO/USACE MTC laboratory accreditation standards), and the tentative acquisition milestone schedule. USACE-SPK anticipates issuing a formal solicitation under NAICS 541360in February 2027., and highly encourage participation from regional small businesses, prospective joint venture partners, and specialty subcontractors who intend to compete. Scope of Work and Technical Capabilities USACE-SPK seeks firms with the capabilities to provide comprehensive geotechnical drilling, cone penetrometer testing (CPT) services, and test-pit excavations utilizing backhoes and track hoes. The principal features of the work encompass soil drilling and sampling utilizing hollow-stem flight augers, solid-stem flight augers, mud-rotary, air-rotary, and percussion drilling methods, including ODEX, Down-hole Casing Advance Systems, or other specialized percussion drilling systems. Contract requirements will also mandate sonic drilling and sampling, alongside rock core drilling and sampling of up to 6-inch diameter using wireline or conventional diamond-impregnated drill bits. Soil sampling operations will require standard penetrometers and other split-barrel samplers up to 3-inch-diameter, as well as undisturbed soil sampling using Shelby push tubes and Pitcher barrels with Pitcher tubes. Field operations will further include CPT testing, piezometer and inclinometer installations, hydraulic pressure testing associated with rock core drilling, and observation well installation and development, which includes pump, permeability, and percolation testing. Contractors will be responsible for generating all associated documentation, to include detailed drill logs, trench or test-pit logs, as-built diagrams for all instrumentation and well installations, and percolation test records. Additionally, the contractor must occasionally furnish the professional services of a registered, licensed Geologist or Geotechnical Engineer. Furthermore, firms must possess the capability to provide certified geotechnical laboratory services. The required testing scope includes moisture content, soil classification, sieve analysis, hydrometer, Atterberg limits, consolidation, triaxial testing, direct shear, California Bearing Ratio (CBR), organic content, and Specific Gravity. To ensure data integrity, all laboratory testing must be performed by a facility accredited by the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) in accordance with the corresponding ASTM standards. Finally, the laboratory must be, or successfully become, validated by the USACE Materials Testing Center (MTC) for all requested testing methods. title: Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) Launch Services
description: NASA Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) Launch Services 2026 On-Ramp The NASA Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) Launch Services Request for Proposal (RFP) was issued on May 27, 2021 and remains open for a period of five years from the effective date through the use of an innovative on-ramp provision found in Section 2.11, Clause 2.11.1. The VADR contract�s ordering period remains valid through five years from date of contract award. Currently, there are 13 eligible providers as part of the Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ). These providers are Arrow Science and Technology, LLC, Astra Space, Inc., Blue Origin, LLC, Firefly Aerospace, Inc., Impulse Space, Inc., L2 Solutions, LLC, Momentus Space, LLC, Northrup Grumman System Corp., Phantom Space Corp., Relativity Space, Inc., Rocket Lab USA, Inc., Space Exploration Technologies, Corp., and United Launch Services, LLC. During the life of the solicitation and at the time established via synopsis, the Government will accept proposals from launch service providers for new IDIQ contracts. At a minimum, launch services proposed under VADR require the below: 1. Launch site agreements for at least one launch site to be used in support of task orders awarded under this contract. 2. Evidence of at least one of the following: Launch attempt (intentional ignition) of common launch vehicle configuration being proposed including, but not limited to, the outcome of the launch attempt Successful launch reaching an altitude of 100km or greater (can include any launch vehicle in the Offeror�s fleet) Development tests demonstrating at least 50% of the flight thrust at the complete full-scale single engine assembly level for all core stage engines of the common launch vehicle configuration being proposed. 3. If Offeror is proposing to use a launch vehicle provided by another company e.g., broker services, transfer vehicle, agreements will be required for each proposed vehicle. Original RFP link: https://sam.gov/opp/587b4fae322942b292baccda3098ae13/view (copy and paste into browser) The anticipated RFP will be restricted to domestic sources as described below: DOMESTIC SOURCE CRITERIA In addition to the certification regarding United States commercial provider of space transportation services (Public Law 105?303, Title II, Section 201), the Contractor shall continue to comply with domestic source criteria established below and with United States National Space Transportation Policy, dated November 21, 2013. Failure to comply with the criteria may be grounds for �Termination for Cause� in accordance with FAR 52.212?4(m). Participation in this procurement is restricted to prime Contractors from the United States launch vehicle/services industry. �United States industry� means any corporation, partnership, joint venture, association, or other entity which is organized or existing under the laws of the United States or any State, and whose controlling interest is held by United States citizens. �Launch services� means all services required in the performance of this contract, excluding those necessary to produce or manufacture launch vehicles, its components and other equipment and facilities required in the performance of the contract. �Controlling interest� means ownership of an amount of equity in such entity sufficient to direct management or to void transactions entered into by management. Ownership of at least fifty?one (51) percent of the equity creates a rebuttable presumption that such interest is controlling; however, the ultimate determination as to whether the interest is controlling resides with NASA. The Contractor shall provide in the performance of this contract launch vehicles that are domestic end products. The launch vehicle shall be a domestic end product only if the cost of its components, mined, produced or manufactured in the United States exceeds 50 percent of the cost of all its components. The cost of each component includes transportation costs to the place of incorporation into the launch vehicle and any applicable duty (whether or not a duty?free entry certificate is issued). �Components,� as used in this contract clause, means those materials and supplies directly incorporated into the end product. The Contractor shall provide, in the performance of this contract, domestic launch services. Launch services shall be considered to be domestic if the cost for launch services performed by United States industry sources exceeds 50 percent of the cost of the total required launch services. It is requested that any interested party notify NASA of intent to submit a proposal during this on-ramp period as well as a description of the launch vehicle configuration(s) you intend to propose and current flight manifest. If no viable responses are received, NASA will not conduct a 2026 VADR On-Ramp. An ombudsman has been appointed in accordance with NFS 1852.215-84.

At this time the Government is considering a Non-Appropriated Funds Instrumentality (NAFI) contract established with a profit share model. Under this concession, the Contractor would operate as a commercial enterprise that earns a profit: the Contractor would account for all gross receipts, deduct verified allowable operational expenses (including monthly utility costs), retain a profit as stipulated in the contract, and pay the agreed upon percentage to the Government. The Contractor would be strictly fiscally liable for all operational, security, and administrative liabilities (including lost keys, re-keying, badge replacements, screening costs, environmental remediation, and fines), all of which shall be deducted directly from the Contractor's retained profit and shall not reduce the Government's net remittance. Additionally, the Government is considering mandating the contractor to pay a local living wage for employees based on the Klamath County living wage rate. This exceeds the Service Contract Act (SCA) Wage rates. Interested contractors should reply in email with a completed Sources Sought response form.

title: Enhanced Mobile Satellite Services (EMSS) Equipment, Provisioning and Customer Care Help Desk Support
description: The United States Space Force (USSF) provides United States Government (USG) and other sponsored customers with satellite communication services through a dedicated, government-controlled gateway. The secure gateway communicates with the contracted commercial Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellation, and traffic processed through the secure gateway may be routed through secure government networks, public telephone networks, or other third-party networks. The program provides cradle-to-grave services and support to its customers, including baseline network airtime access, sale and provisioning of authorized devices, 24/7/365 dedicated help-desk support, enhanced Government capabilities such as encrypted communications, comprehensive operation and maintenance of the secure gateway, and other services. The objective of this possible follow-on effort is to deliver provisioning support and 24/7/365 dedicated help desk support to all authorized EMSS customers, including the Department of War (DoW), Federal Government, State and Local Government, approved foreign and allied governments, and other sponsored customers. The contractor may be required to provide EMSS Service Management services including Telecommunications Service Order (TSO) order management, warranty support, inventory management, supply chain functions, sub-contract management, provisioning activities, gateway liaison services, Return Material Authorization support, reporting, and program management. The scope includes provisioning, invoicing, record management, and customer care services for users who access the commercial satellite constellation through the secure gateway. Services include Telephony (Voice), Data Transmission (Circuit and Packet Switched), Short Burst Data messaging, Tactical Push-to-Talk voice and data, Paging and Alerting, Multicast Data Broadcasts, High-Speed Broadband services, Secure Voice, enhancements/evolutions of those services, and additional commercial services introduced during the period of performance and included under separately managed baseline access agreements. The Performance Work Statement (PES) contained in this posting is a secured attachment. To get access please submit a request through SAM.gov, including at a minimium POC name/contact information, vendor/entity name and CAGE code. Only vendors with Active SAM Registration will be considered for granted access and the Government reserves the right to deny access as it sees fit. These additional security measures are to comply with SF/SSC PA guidance.

title: Market Survey for PVS-14 White Phosphor Image Intensifier Tubes
description: The Defense Logistics Agency-Aberdeen, on behalf of the Army Integrated Logistics Supply Center (ILSC) � Supply Chain Management Directorate (SCMD) � Strategic Sourcing Directorate (SSD), intends to acquire Parts to support the AN/PVS-14. Requirements Description: The United States Army is looking for sources (manufacturers) with the ability to provide the Image Intensifier Tube, (NSN: 5855-01-699-1065) for the AN/PVS-14. The Image Intensifier Tube is a component to the Monocular Night Vision Device (MNVD), AN/PVS-14, which is a night vision system that amplifies ambient light (moonlight, stars, skyglow, etc.) and provides improved night vision. The Image Intensifier is the component responsible for amplifying ambient light. The Government possesses limited technical data in the form of an interface control drawing. The Government requires an estimated quantity of 81,281 Image Intensifier Tubes (NSN 5855-01-699-1065) over a 5-year period. This is not a solicitation. This is only an estimate and will not bind the contractor or the Government in any way or at any time into a contract with any of the specified terms below. Suppliers who can supply this item should contact the government before December 10, 2026. Submissions can be sent to brandon.t.hepner.civ@army.mil. Responses must include a list of items the supplier is able to produce or source as well as documentation that the supplier can provide the army with a physically and functionally component from the list above. Examples of such documentation can be test results, copy of purchase orders if the supplier was a vendor to the listed source, or a statement from listed source demonstrating that the supplier can provide the Army a solution. For more information contact Brandon Hepner at brandon.t.hepner.civ@army.mil. Items and/or Services to Be Procured: NSN: 5855-01-699-1065 NOMENCLATURE: MX-11769 Image Intensifier Tube PART NUMBER: A3297310-1 or A3297320-1 Requested Response Information: We request that sources who can manufacture the listed parts or services to submit information to show their capability. At a minimum the support information you submit should include, but is not limited to, the following types of documentation: Questionnaire, information on previous Government and commercial contracts, and evidence that the item can be provided. In your response, please include your company name, CAGE code, and a technical point of contact with email address and telephone number. Notice, Response Due Date, and Points of Contact: This is NOT a Request for Quote or Proposal. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this SSA or reimburse any costs associated with the preparation of responses to this SSA. This Sources sought announcement (SSA) is for planning and market research purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government. The information gathered from this announcement will be used to determine if responsible sources exist, and to assist in determining if this effort can be competitive and/or set aside for Small Business. Furthermore, the Government will use the information, in part, to determine the best acquisition strategy for a potential procurement action and/or to assist in making acquisition strategy decisions in the future. All SSA responses should be emailed to the Technical and Competition Advocate Points of Contact at the email addresses listed below. No phone inquiries will be accepted, either as a response to this action or for information requests. All requests for information must be submitted via email to the Technical Point of Contact and the Competition Advocate. Please submit responses by 12/10/2026 Technical Point of Contact: Brandon Hepner (brandon.t.hepner.civ@army.mil)

title: C2IMERA WARDEN - Virtual Industry Day Announcement - Save The Day!
description: C2IMERA WARDEN Virtual Industry Day Announcement � Save The Date WARDEN Industry Day 17 November 2026 Worldwide Airbase Resiliency, Defense, and Engineering Navigator (WARDEN) I. Background: The Department of the Air Force is conducting market research related to a potential installation emergency-management information-system solution. The project initiative Worldwide Airbase Resiliency, Defense, and Engineering Navigator (WARDEN) seeks to leverage solutions to include agile software development, modern systems engineering, and resilient, interoperable C2 capabilities to protect, mitigate, respond to, and recover airbases, forward operating locations, and contingency sites from physical hazards and emerging threats across the conflict continuum. For prior posted information on the WARDEN effort, please see Request For Information (RFI) Notice ID: FA8730-26-RFI-C2IMERA-WARDEN posted on SAM.gov on 14 October 2026 which included the draft Area of Interest (AOI) and Statement of Objectives (SOO). A Virtual Industry Day serves as a key venue for open dialogue between the Government and Industry Partners. It will help inform industry's understanding of upcoming requirements and shape the Government's overall acquisition strategy. II. Save the Date for the Virtual Industry Day: In a continuous effort to provide increased transparency and information to our Industry Partners, AFLCMC/C3CW Program Management Office invites interested vendors to participate in our Virtual Industry Day for the WARDEN Acquisition effort. Wednesday, December 9, 2026: Unclassified Session � Microsoft Teams Thursday, December 10, 2026: Unclassified Session � Microsoft Teams The Government intends to provide the Full Schedule and Agenda prior to the Virtual Industry Day no later than 7 December 2026. Location: Virtual via NIPRNet Microsoft Teams. Link will be sent out to all RSVPs participants prior to the Industry Day, and no later than 7 December 2026. III. Lightening Networking Sessions: To facilitate and encourage broad industry participation, the Government anticipates hosting Lightning Networking Sessions on Day 1 and/or Day 2. Purpose: This is a dedicated opportunity for interested vendors to showcase their company�s capabilities in a quick, 5-minute presentation to the entire audience for potential networking opportunities. Objective: To compile a comprehensive vendor pool contact list, stimulate teaming opportunities, and encourage potential joint partnerships between vendors for the WARDEN effort. RSVP Deadline: Vendors wishing to present must explicitly say so when RSVPing to the event no later than December 1, 2026. Once a schedule is finalized, presenters will be notified of their exact date and timeslot no later than December 7, 2026. IV. Information Restrictions: No recording, transcription, photography, screen capture, or redistribution of event content is authorized unless specifically approved in writing by the Government. Participants must not display, discuss, submit, or distribute classified information, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), export-controlled information, or proprietary information during the general session. Any controlled information, if subsequently determined necessary, will be addressed only through separately authorized procedures, approved recipients, and an appropriate environment. Attendance is limited to participants who complete the Government�s approved registration process. The Government will provide event-access instructions to approved registrants. Registration does not independently establish a need-to-know, authorization to receive controlled information, or eligibility for a future award. V. Eligibility: Foreign Participation & FOCI Restrictions U.S. Citizens Only: Attendance is strictly restricted to U.S. citizens. Foreign nationals, non-U.S. entities, and dual nationals holding foreign citizenship are not authorized to participate. FOCI Ineligibility: U.S. entities operating under unmitigated Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) are ineligible to register. Security Clearance Requirements Industry Day Clearance: A Secret facility clearance is not required to attend the Industry Day or participate in the Lightning Networking Sessions. However, future solicitation requirements may require a Secret facility clearance. Joint Certification Program (DD Form 2345) Not Required for Attendance: A DD Form 2345 (Military Critical Technical Data Agreement) is not required to attend the Industry Day or participate in the Lightning Networking Sessions. Future Requirement: This certificate may be required at a later date to bid on the solicitation. For interested contractors who do not currently hold an approved DD Form 2345 and are interested to start the registration process, please check the Defense Logistics Agency Joint Certification Program (JCP) Website: https://www.dla.mil/logistics-operations/services/joint-certification-program/. VI. Registration Process All registration must be submitted to the Government Contracting POCs listed below. The Contracting team will consolidate and coordinate directly with the Security Office for security pre-vetting and provide confirmation of final registration. Step 1: Submit Pre-Vetting & Registration Request (Deadline: December 6, 2026) Email below POCs with the following details: � First & Last Name of All Attendees � Company Name & CAGE Code � Company Address & Phone Numbers � Reference "WARDEN Industry Day Pre-Vetting � Your Company Name" in the email subject line. Step 2: Indicate Lightning Session Participation (Deadline: December 1, 2026) If you wish to present a 5-minute brief to foster teaming, explicitly state this in your registration email. Include your presenter's name, title, email, phone. Step 3: Submit DD Form 2345 (Optional) Submit your approved DD Form 2345 via email or DoD SAFE Drop-Off to the below POCs. Once vetted and approved, the contracting team will send a single confirmation email containing your MS Teams meeting links. VII. Government Points of Contact (POCs): All registration, pre-vetting, Lightning Networking RSVPs, and DD Form 2345 submissions must be sent to the following: Angela Lynch, Contracting Officer/Agreements Officer, email: angela.lynch.3@us.af.mil; Annie Kazi, Contracting Specialist/Agreement Specialist, email: annie.kazi@us.af.mil; Leonardo Dominguez, Capt, Contract Specialist/Agreement Specialist, email: leonardo.dominguez.1@us.af.mil

title: Just In Time Services II (JITSII)
description: Request for Information (RFI)/Draft SOW/Sources Sought THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. NO PROPOSALS ARE TO BE SUBMITTED IN RESPONSE TO THIS NOTICE. NASA/Johnson Space Center (JSC) is hereby soliciting information from potential sources for the Just in Time Services II (JITS II) acquisition. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 424120, Office Supplies Merchant Wholesalers. NASA intends to solicit this requirement as a FAR 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services as it�s considered to be a commercial product as defined in FAR 2.101. The anticipated solicitation-release date is the second quarter of Fiscal Year 2027. Performance would commence no earlier than October 15, 2027, with a total potential period of performance of 5 years. It is anticipated that this procurement will be awarded to a single contractor. PART 1- REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)/DRAFT SOW This notice is issued by the NASA/Johnson Space Center (JSC) to post a draft Statement of Work (SOW) to solicit responses from interested parties. The SOW document is for information and planning purposes and to allow industry the opportunity to verify reasonableness and feasibility of the requirement, as well as promote competition. This RFI/Draft SOW is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, nor will the Government pay for the information submitted in response. The Government may not respond to questions/concerns submitted. The Government will use the information to finalize the RFP as necessary. The elements of the SOW are provided in the attached file. PART 2- SOURCES SOUGHT NASA JSC is seeking capability statements from all interested parties, including all socioeconomic categories of Small Businesses (SB) and Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCU)/Minority Institutions (MI) for the purposes of determining the appropriate level of competition and/or small business subcontracting goals for JITS II. Vendors are encouraged to demonstrate capabilities as a prime, subcontractor and/or teaming partner. The Government reserves the right to consider a Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB), HUBZone, Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB), Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, and Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) set-aside based on responses received. INDUSTRY RESPONSE If your organization has the potential capacity to perform the contract services listed above, please provide the following information to the best of your ability. Partial responses are also accepted. Organization information Name and address Point of Contact (name, email address, telephone number) CAGE/Unique Entity ID (sam.gov) Number of years in business. List of customers covering the past three years (highlight relevant work performed, contract numbers, contract type, dollar value of each procurement). Provide capability statement and discuss your company�s ability to perform each of the services listed in this notice. Provide confirmation as a potential suitable source as Offeror must be authorized to distribute AbilityOne products by the Committee for Purchase from People Who are Blind or Severely Disabled (Committee) and meet requirements defined in Executive Order 13834. It is insufficient to provide only general brochures or general information. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to a) provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated; and b) determine whether to conduct a competition with full and open competition or through a small business set-aside. If the Government issues a Request for Proposal (RFP) the government reserves the right to restrict the procurement to small businesses. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. All responses, comments or questions must be submitted electronically via email to Damian Gillette (damian.p.gillette@nasa.gov) and Rogelio Curiel (rogelio.curiel-1@nasa.gov), no later than December 10, 2027, 4PM CT. When responding reference 80JSC027JITSII. NASA Clause 1852.215-84, Ombudsman, is applicable. The Center Ombudsman for this acquisition can be found at: https://www.hq.nasa.gov/office/procurement/regs/Procurement-Ombuds-Comp-Advocate-Listing.pdf If a solicitation is released, then it and any additional documents will be available on Sam.gov. It is the offeror's responsibility to monitor this website for the release of the solicitation and amendments (if any). Potential offerors will be responsible for downloading their own copy of the solicitation and amendments, if any.

title: Area of Interest (AoI) for Radar Capability for MADIS and L-MADIS
description: Program Manager Ground Based Air Defense (PM GBAD) is seeking mature commercial Radar solutions. Product Manager (PdM) Future Weapons Systems (FWS) is issuing this AoI to identify and acquire mature commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) or near-COTS radar technologies that can be rapidly modified and integrated into the Marine Air Defense Integrated System (MADIS) and Light-MADIS (L-MADIS). PdM FWS is seeking a solution that provides existing commercial radar capabilities and the specific tactical, physical, and network requirements of these highly mobile defense platforms. The authority to issue this CSO AoI is derived from M67854-27-S-0015, dated 19 November 2026. The CSO authority is 10 U.S.C. � 3458 � Authority to acquire innovative commercial products and commercial services using general solicitation competitive procedures and DFARS 212.70 � Defense Commercial Solutions Opening.

description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung über die Produktion, die bedarfsweise Lagerung und der Versand verschiedener Printmedien unter Nutzung eines individualisierten Online-Bestellshops. title: Udbud af Rehabiliteringsydelser på specialiseret niveau
description: Kommende Region Østdanmark udbyder en kontrakt vedrørende levering af specialiseret rehabilitering til patienter med behov for et intensivt, tværfagligt og specialiseret rehabiliteringsforløb. Formålet med udbuddet er at sikre regionens patienter adgang til rehabiliteringsydelser af høj faglig kvalitet, leveret af leverandører med de nødvendige specialiserede kompetencer, kapacitet og organisatoriske rammer. Leverandøren skal understøtte sammenhængende patientforløb gennem tæt samarbejde og koordinering med regionens hospitaler, kommuner og øvrige relevante aktører. Ydelserne omfatter døgnbaserede rehabiliteringsforløb for patienter, der efter sygehusbehandling har behov for fortsat specialiseret rehabilitering med henblik på at opnå størst mulig funktionsevne, selvstændighed og livskvalitet. Udbuddet gennemføres af Region Hovedstaden og Region Sjælland på vegne af den kommende Region Østdanmark, som vil være kontraktpart ved kontraktens ikrafttrædelse.

Rådgivningen kan desuden omfatte særskilt beskrevne ydelser vedrørende blandt andet forundersøgelser, myndighedsforhold, interessentinddragelse, digitale leverancer, bæredygtighed, arbejdsmiljøkoordinering, byggeledelse og fagtilsyn. Der henvises i øvrigt til udbudsmaterialet for en mere detaljeret beskrivelse.

description: Unter dem Vorbehalt der Bereitstellung von Haushaltsmitteln in der erforderlichen Höhe besteht folgender Bedarf: 86.000 Paar Laufsocken gem. TL-B 214, Ausgabe 10/2026 Vertragszeitraum: bis 09.05.2029; 2 x 12 Monate Option. Am 01. Januar 2014 ist das Niedersächsische Gesetz zur Sicherung von Tariftreue und Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe von öffentlichen Aufträgen (Niedersächsisches Tariftreue- und Vergabegesetz - NTVergG) in Kraft getreten. Dieses Gesetz soll einen fairen Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge gewährleisten sowie die umwelt- und sozialveträgliche Beschaffung durch die öffentliche Hand fördern. Das NTVergG findet Anwendung auf alle öffentlichen Aufträge über Bau-, Dienst- und Lieferleistungen, einschließlich Dienstleistungen im Bereich des öffentlichen Personenverkehrs (ÖPNV) - ab einem geschätzten Auftragswert von 20.000,00 EUR (netto). Die Vergabe des Auftrags erfolgt gem. § 3 Absatz 1 NTVergG nach den Regelungen der Unterschwellenvergabeordnung (UVgO) vom 2. Februar 2017. Auf § 2 UVgO (Grundsätze der Vergabe) wird hingewiesen. Des Weiteren wird auf einige Grundsatzregelungen des Gesetzes gegen Wettbewerbsbeschränkungen (GWB), insbesondere § 97 Abs. 1 bis 6 GWB, verwiesen. Das Angebot ist elektronisch in Textform, über die Vergabeplattform, einzureichen. *NTVergG = Niedersächsisches Gesetz zur Sicherung von Tariftreue und Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge (Niedersächsisches Tariftreue- und Vergabegesetz) in der Fassung vom 20.01.2020.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Planungsleistungen für das Projekt Neubau eines Feuerwehrhauses mit Multifunktionshalle
description: Leistungen: Im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens sollen Planungsleistungen für das Projekt Neubau eines Feuerwehrhauses mit Multifunktionshalle in Pollenfeld vergeben werden. Verfahrensgegenständlich sind die folgenden Leistungen: Grundleistungen der Objektplanung, Leistungsbilder Gebäude und Innenräume, HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1 bis 9; Erstellung Brandschutznachweis gemäß § 11 BauVorlV (Besondere Leistung); Energieberatung einschl. Beratung zu KfW-Förderung und Erstellung des GEG-Nachweises (besondere Leistung); Vermessung des Baugrundstücks im Zuge der Planung (besondere Leistung); Durchführung von Planungsworkshop(s) (besondere Leistung); vertiefte Kostenschätzung in Bezug auf das Raumprogramm, die es ermöglicht, verschiedene Varianten raumbezogener Einsparpotentiale darzustellen, und die alle Anforderungswünsche des Arbeitskreises für die Multifunktionshalle und damit verbundene Kostensteigerungen bzw. Einsparpotentiale berücksichtigt (besondere Leistung); Überwachen der Mängelbeseitigung innerhalb der Verjährungsfrist (besondere Leistung). Die Beauftragung erfolgt stufenweise nach Abruf. Zum Baugrundstück: Der Neubau soll auf dem Grundstück mit der Flurnummer 354, Gemarkung Preith, erfolgen. Das Grundstück steht im Eigentum des Auftraggebers und ist aktuell unbebaut sowie nicht erschlossen. Der Bereich des Grundstücks, auf dem der Neubau entstehen soll, wird derzeit vom Auftraggeber überplant. Das Bebauungsplanverfahren zum Bebauungsplan Preith Nr. 30 „Gemeindebedarf am Zachenweg“ befindet sich in der Phase der zweiten Auslegung und wird voraussichtlich Ende 2026 abgeschlossen sein. Zum Neubau: Die Maßnahme umfasst den Neubau eines Feuerwehrhauses mit Fahrzeughalle, Einsatz- und Umkleidebereichen, Schulungs- und Verwaltungsbereichen, Werkstatt, Lagerflächen, Technikflächen sowie Außenanlagen mit Übungshof und Stellplätzen. Ebenfalls soll das Feuerwehrgerätehaus noch eine Multifunktionshalle als Anbau erhalten. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt die Herstellung eines funktionalen und wirtschaftlichen Neubaus mit überwiegend robustem und nachhaltigem „LowTech“-Ansatz. Vorgesehen sind kompakte Baukörperstrukturen, langlebige Materialien sowie ein wartungsarmer Gebäudebetrieb. Besondere Anforderungen ergeben sich aus der Nutzung als kritische Infrastruktur, Betriebssicherheit sowie den feuerwehrspezifischen Funktionsabläufen. Stand der Planungen: Der Auftraggeber hat im Vorfeld des Verfahrens folgende Planungen / Studien erstellen lassen: Entwurf einer Raumaufteilung mit Raumprogramm, der allerdings einen anderen Projektstandort betrifft. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, an den Raumfunktionen und den jeweiligen Raumgrößen des Entwurfs festzuhalten. Die Raumaufteilung wird jedoch an den aktuellen Standort anzupassen und zu ändern sein, wobei sich Änderungswünsche auch aus Besichtigung anderer Häuser ableiten werden. Zu Beginn des Planungsauftrages hat der Auftragnehmer die Änderungswünsche gemeinsam mit Nutzern und Auftraggeber zu prüfen, zu validieren und ggf. in die Grundlage Raumprogramm einzuarbeiten. Kosten und Termine: Die Kosten des Projekts (Bau- und Planungskosten) werden derzeit auf rund 4,5 Mio. € brutto geschätzt. Die Schätzung basiert auf der Annahme, dass vorhandene Einsparpotentiale realisiert werden, was derzeit Ziel des Auftraggebers ist. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, für das Projekt Zuwendungen zu erlangen, insbesondere Zuwendungen des Freistaates Bayern zur Förderung des kommunalen Feuerwehrwesens, LAG-Förderung, BAFA-Förderung etc. Der Auftraggeber geht derzeit von folgendem Projektablauf aus: Planungsbeginn: II. Quartal 2027, sofort nach Zuschlagserteilung; Einreichung Bauantrag: IV. Quartal 2027; Ausschreibung der Bauleistungen: IV. Quartal 2027; Voraussichtlicher Baubeginn: II. Quartal 2028; Voraussichtliche Fertigstellung/Inbetriebnahme: Anfang/Mitte 2030. Zum Ablauf der Planung gilt Folgendes: Im Rahmen der HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1 und 2 soll zunächst das Feuerwehr haus auf Basis des bereits vorliegenden Raumprogramms und der Raumaufteilung, die noch Änderungen unterliegen wird, sowie das gesamte Raumprogramm für die Multifunktionshalle nach den Anforderungswünschen des Arbeitskreises geplant werden. Synergien sind hierbei bestmöglich einzuplanen. So kann beispielsweise ein separater Schulungsraum für die Feuerwehr entfallen, da hierfür die Multifunktionshalle mitbenutzt werden kann. Nach Abschluss der HOAI-Leistungsphase 2 und Vorliegen der vertieften Kostenschätzung wird die Vorplanung im Gemeinderat des Auftraggebers evaluiert werden. Die Kostenschätzung ist so aufzubereiten, dass sie es ermöglicht, verschiede Varianten raumbezogener Einsparpotentiale darzustellen. Die Kostenschätzung hat auch alle Anforderungswünsche des Arbeitskreises für die Multifunktionshalle und damit verbundene Kostensteigerungen bzw. Einsparpotentiale zu berücksichtigen. Der Gemeinderat wird im Zuge der Evaluierung eine Optimierung der Planung sowie eine Anpassung und ggf. Reduzierung des Raumprogramms vornehmen. Im Falle des Abrufes wird in der HOAI-Leistungsphase 3 mit einer entsprechend angepassten und ggf. reduzierten Planung weitergeplant. Während der gesamten Planungsphase sind von Auftragnehmer sowohl der Gemeinderat als auch die Feuerwehr als auch der zuständige Arbeitskreis eng miteinzubeziehen.

description: Die Lambertischule in Coesfeld, Katthagen 10, 48653 Coesfeld, wird um einen Neubau erweitert. Das Gebäude wird als Massivholzbau erstellt und bekommt ein Flachdach, auf dem sich die Lüftungsanlagen und die Wärmepumpe befinden. Das Gebäude hat die Grundmaße von ca. 20 x 20m und eine Gebäudegrundfläche von ca. 750 m². Der Neubau wird durch einen anschließenden Zwischentrakt an das denkmalgeschützte Bestandsgebäude angeschlossen. Die Wärmeversorgung des Neubaus erfolgt über eine auf der Dachfläche aufgestellte Luft/Wasser-Wärmepumpe. Die Be- und Entlüftung des Neubaus erfolgt über zwei zentrale Lüftungsgeräte, die auf der Dachfläche des Gebäudes aufgestellt werden. title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – 2026-1005147_Flughafen München_ Generalplanung Neubau Mobilitätszentrum (MOZ)
description: Die Flughafen München GmbH (FMG) beabsichtigt, im öffentlichen Bereich zwischen den beiden Passagier-Terminals, der sogenannten Zentralen Zone, ein neues Mobilitätszentrum (MOZ bzw. das Projekt) zu errichten, um zukünftig u.a. das Mietwagengeschäft sowie Car Sharing-Dienste zentral anbieten und abwickeln zu können. Das MOZ als Bindeglied zwischen luftseitigem Passagierverkehr und landseitigem Individualverkehr wird in die vorhandene Verkehrsinfrastruktur der Zentrale Zone eingebunden. Der Neubau des MOZ wird bestehende Einrichtungen, die bisher im Zentralgebäude des München Airport Center (MAC) und in den Parkhäusern P5 und P6 untergebracht sind, ersetzen, um der steigenden Nachfrage nach Mietfahrzeugen und Carsharing-Diensten Rechnung tragen. Das MOZ wird dabei alle Prozessschritte des Mietwagengeschäfts sowohl auf der Kundenseite (Vertragsabschluss, Fahrzeugübernahme und Fahrzeugrückgabe) als auch auf der Anbieterseite (Fahrzeugrücknahme, -aufbereitung und -bereitstellung) in einem Gebäudekomplex bündeln. Hierfür steht ein Baufeld von ca. 46.000 m² zur Verfügung. Das MOZ besteht aus drei einzelnen, aber miteinander verbundenen Gebäudeteilen: der Counterhalle, dem Mietwagen bzw. Car-Sharing Parkhaus und dem Servicegebäude samt Aufbereitungseinrichtungen: 1. Counterhalle als Kopfbau auf ca. 4.000 m² Grundfläche, welche sich über zwei oberirdischen Etagen erstreckt (Kundenverkehr im EG sowie Bürobereich im 1.OG). 2. Systemparkaus mit acht Etagen auf einer Grundfläche von ca. 21.000 m² und einer Mindestzahl von 5.400 Stellplätzen. 3. Servicegebäude bzw.-bereich mit ca. 7.000 m² Grundfläche und bis zu zwei oberirdischen Etagen mit folgenden Funktionen: - Fahrzeugwaschanlagen - Tankstelle - Sonderreinigungs- und Werkstattbereiche inkl. Büro und Nebenräume - Technikraume im UG Hinzu kommen Außenanlagen inkl. Betriebsstraßen mit einer Grundfläche von ca. 14.000 m².

Der neue Anbau West umfasst flexibel nutzbare Räume für Business-Events, Konferenzen und Firmenfeiern sowie Büro- und Gastronomiebereiche. Im Erdgeschoss entstehen die erforderlichen Funktionsräume für den Eissportbetrieb und die Veranstaltungsakteure. Für die Gäste der Eishockeyspiele ist eine Business-Lounge mit direktem Anschluss an den Tribünenbereich vorgesehen. Im 1. Obergeschoss soll die Esplanade erweitert werden, um die engen Passagen im Bereich der Kioske und bestehenden Sanitäranlagen zu entzerren und neu zu organisieren. Im Zuge der Erweiterung wird zudem der Nordeingang aufgewertet und um einen Fanshop sowie einen Kiosk ergänzt. Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen umfassen sämtliche vorbereitenden Maßnahmen, Rückbau-, Erd-, Fundamentierungs- und erweiterten Rohbauarbeiten zur Errichtung der nördlichen und westlichen Gebäudeanbauten am Bestandsgebäude. Hierzu zählen insbesondere die erforderlichen Abbruch- und Demontagearbeiten, die Herstellung der Fundamente sowie die Errichtung der Anbauten in Mischbauweise einschließlich der Verbunddeckenkonstruktionen und des verbindenden Zwischengangs. Die Arbeiten erfolgen teilweise im laufenden Betrieb, weshalb besondere Anforderungen an Staubschutz, Baustellenabtrennung sowie die durchgehende Sicherstellung der Flucht- und Rettungswege zu berücksichtigen sind.

description: The Decentralization and Good Governance Program (PADRE III) ended in December 2025. As part of the consolidation of the achievements of this project, the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany, during the intergovernmental consultations on bilateral cooperation between the Government of the Republic of Mali and the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany held on May 22, 2025, expressed its wish to continue to support the approach of PADRE III. This commitment of the German side has been concretized by the formulation of the Project Resilient Regional Structures and Socio-Economic Development in Mali (PADRE+), commissioned end of 2025. The PADRE+ Project is funded by the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). Its aim is to create, in its areas of intervention, favourable conditions for the promotion of socio-economic development and wealth creation and the provision of quality basic public services through local authorities, in accordance with the principles of good governance. The current phase of implementation runs from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027. Its institutional supervision in Mali is ensured by the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralization (MATD) in Mali through the General Directorate of Local Authorities (DGCT/ Direction Générale des Collectivités territoriales). The project operates in four (04) regions of Mali, namely Koulikoro, Ségou, San et Gao. It aims to strengthen the capacities of public and private actors at regional and municipality level in order to enable them to jointly provide the necessary impetus for economic development that meets the needs of the population. It is based on three (03) areas of intervention: 1. Strengthening the institutional capacities of selected regions (partner regions) and municipalities in view of inclusive local socio-economic development; 2. Deepening public-private dialogue on joint and inclusive planning of development measures; 3. Improving the entrepreneurial capacities of private sector actors in the regions of intervention. PADRE + is a continuation of the previous Decentralization and Good Governance Program (PADRE III) and contributes to the strengthening of the achievements of the project while aiming for the sustainability of the impacts. The PADRE+ project aims to promote regional and local economic development through the deepening of decentralization in the regions and municipalities of intervention and provides local support and advice to regional and municipal actors in improving the provision of basic public services as well as in conducting a sustained process of economic growth based on the development of the private sector.

title: Germany – Construction project management services – Wiederaufbau der Bornplatzsynagoge am Joseph-Carlebach-Platz in Hamburg - Projektsteuerung und Unterstützung der Projektleitung
description: Die Jüdische Gemeinde in Hamburg beabsichtigt die Wiedererrichtung der im Jahr 1938 zerstörten historischen Bornplatzsynagoge am Joseph-Carlebach-Platz im Hamburger Grindelviertel. Das Vorhaben knüpft an die historische, religiöse und städtebauliche Bedeutung des Ortes an und verfolgt das Ziel, einen zentralen Ort jüdischen Glaubens, jüdischer Kultur und jüdischen Gemeindelebens im Stadtraum Hamburgs wieder sichtbar und erlebbar zu machen. Auf Grundlage einer Machbarkeitsstudie sowie eines unterdessen abgeschlossenen nicht-offenen, zweiphasigen hochbaulich-freiraumplanerischen Realisierungswettbewerbs wird das Projekt im Sinne einer kritischen Rekonstruktion weiterentwickelt. Die Kubatur und äußere Erscheinung des historischen Hauptbaukörpers sollen in Anlehnung an den 1906 errichteten Vorgängerbau wiederhergestellt werden, während die innere Organisation, technische Ausstattung und Sicherheitskonzeption zeitgemäßen funktionalen, gesellschaftlichen und nachhaltigen Anforderungen folgen. Das Projekt umfasst den Neubau einer orthodoxen Synagoge als Hauptbaukörper, ergänzende Gemeinde-, Bildungs- und Verwaltungsbereiche sowie einen zusätzlichen liberalen Synagogenraum. Bestandteil des Vorhabens ist zudem die Neugestaltung der umgebenden Freiräume im Zusammenspiel mit dem Grindelhof sowie dem Allende- und Joseph-Carlebach-Platz. Aufgrund der herausragenden städtebaulichen, historischen und gesellschaftlichen Bedeutung des Ortes sowie der besonderen Sicherheitsrelevanz erfordert das Vorhaben eine integrierte und besonders enge Steuerung aller Projektbeteiligten und Belange dieses Projektes.

description: Der Auftraggeber plant die interimistische Unterbringung der Radionuklidlabore aus den Gebäuden NI/NT auf dem Campus der Ruhr-Universität Bochum (RUB). Hintergrund ist der geplante Rückbau der Gebäude NI/NT, in deren Zuge die dort betriebenen Radionuklidlabore bis zur Fertigstellung des Neubaukomplexes NB übergangsweise untergebracht werden müssen. Der Übergangszeitraum wird derzeit mit 7 bis 8 Jahren veranschlagt. Als Interimslösungen wurden Flächen im Gebäude ND identifiziert. Die vorliegende Machbarkeitsstudie vom 18.06.2026 untersucht und be-schreibt die hierfür erforderlichen baulichen und technischen Maßnahmen, um die Bestandsfläche den Anforderungen des Strahlenschutzes entsprechend ertüchtigen zu können. Dabei werden sowohl die baulichen Anpassungen als auch die technische Gebäudeausrüstung betrachtet. Bestehende Nutzungsanforderungen, insbesondere hinsichtlich der Labore der Sicherheitsstufe S2 gemäß GenTSV, werden dabei berücksichtigt und in das Konzept integriert. Ziel ist die Entwicklung einer umsetzbaren, genehmigungsfähigen und wirtschaftlich vertretbaren Interimslösung, die den sicheren Laborbetrieb für den gesamten Übergangszeitraum sicherstellt. Für die raumlufttechnischen Anlagen (KG 430) sind die Fachplanungsleistungen der Leistungsphasen 2 bis 8 gemäß § 55 HOAI 2021 zu erbringen. Diese werden mit Zuschlagserteilung bzw. mit Vertragsschluss übertragen. Für die übrigen Anlagengruppen (KG 410, KG 420, KG 440, KG 450, KG 470 und KG 480) erfolgt zunächst eine Bestandsaufnahme, technische Zustandsfeststellung und Eignungsbewertung der vorhandenen Anlagen im Hinblick auf die Anforderungen der zukünftigen Nutzung als Isotopenlabor. Auf Grundlage dieser Untersuchung ist festzustellen, ob und in welchem Umfang die bestehenden Anlagen weiterverwendet werden können oder Anpassungs-, Erweiterungs- bzw. Erneuerungsmaßnahmen erforderlich sind. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt für diese Anlagengruppen zu diesem Zwecke eine stufenweise Beauftragung.

title: Finland – Repair and maintenance services of machinery – Varavoimakoneiden ja muiden diesel-koneiden vuosihuollot ja testaukset

Työt kohdistuvat Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne Oy:n (Kaupunkiliikenne), Ruskeasuon Varikkokiinteistö Oy:n (Ruha), RV Kalusto ja Varikko Oy:n (Kava), Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitoksen (HKL), Länsimetro Oy:n (Länsimetro) ja Sammalvuoren Metrovarikko Oy:n (SVV) omistamiin tai ylläpitovastuulla oleviin huonetiloihin, rakennuksiin ja kiinteistöihin. Tarkemmin hankittava palvelu ja kohteet on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 3 Palvelukuvaus ja salassapitositoumusta vastaan saatavassa liitteessä 4 Laiteluettelo kohteittain. Tilaajat tekevät jokainen itsenäisen hankintapäätöksen ja hankintasopimukset. Selvennyksen vuoksi todettaan, että Kaupunkiliikenne edustaa kaikkia tilaajia sopimuksen mukaisten palveluiden suorittamiseen liittyvissä asioissa. Hankinta on jaettu osa-alueeseen 1. Kantametro ja varikot (OA1) sekä osa-alueeseen 2. Länsimetro ja SVV (OA2). Hankinnan arvonlisäveroton ennakoitu kokonaisarvo koko sopimuskauden aikana (ml. mahdolliset optiokaudet) on 960.000,00 euroa, josta hankinnan arvot jakautuvat osa-aluekohtaisesti seuraavasti: OA1: 640 000 euroa (alv 0 %). OA2: 320 000 euroa (alv 0 %). Tarjousten valintaperusteena on osa-aluekohtaisesti halvin vertailuhinta. Hankinnan tavoitteena on valita yksi (1) toimittaja kummallekin osa-alueelle. Toimittajaksi valitaan tarjouspyynnön vaatimukset täyttävä tarjoaja, joka on tarjonnut kyseiselle osa-alueelle halvimman hinnan. Osa-alueiden 1 ja 2 toimittajaksi voidaan valita joko sama tai eri toimittaja Sopimuskausi on neljä (4) vuotta. Tämän lisäksi sopimusta voidaan jatkaa enintään kahdella (2) kahden (2) vuoden pituisella optiokaudella. Kukin hankintayksikkö päättää option käyttöönotosta erikseen omalla päätöksellään. Sopimus ei sisällä määrä- eikä vähimmäisostovelvoitetta, eikä se tuota toimittajalle yksinoikeutta palvelun tuottamiseen tilaajalle.

title: Netherlands – Gravel, sand, crushed stone and aggregates – Inkoop zand en grond BRM Harderweide fase 3
description: Deze aanbesteding betreft een Europese aanbesteding ten behoeve van Leveringen overeenkomstig het Aanbestedingsreglement Werken 2016 (hoofdstuk 2) voor de gemeente Harderwijk. Deze openbare aanbesteding is online gepubliceerd. Alle ondernemers, die aan de gestelde eisen voldoen, mogen inschrijven. Op deze opdracht zijn de Uniforme Administratieve Voorwaarden (UAV) van toepassing. De Overeenkomst is geldig voor de duur van het uit te voeren werk. Deze Opdracht wordt in zijn geheel aanbesteed, er is geen sprake van perceelvorming. De Opdracht wordt gegund aan de inschrijver die de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving heeft gedaan op basis van de laagste prijs. De beschrijvingen in Mercell Source-to-Contract, behorend bij deze aanbesteding, bevatten informatie die geïnteresseerde partijen nodig hebben om een beeld te kunnen vormen van de inhoud van de Opdracht om zodoende te kunnen beslissen al dan niet een Inschrijving in te dienen. Daarnaast bevat het Offerteverzoek de benodigde informatie en worden geïnteresseerde partijen door middel van dit Offerteverzoek nader geïnformeerd over de procedure die de Aanbestedende dienst zal volgen om tot een Overeenkomst te komen. Alle informatie in dit Offerteverzoek dient vertrouwelijk te worden behandeld. Leeswijzer Deze aanbesteding zal verlopen via het Digitale Aanbestedingsplatform Mercell Source-to-Contract. Voor het gebruik van Mercell Source-to-Contract is de 'Instructie Digitaal Aanbieden' opgesteld. U kijkt nu naar 'Stap 1: Informatie'. Hier treft u alle informatie omtrent deze aanbesteding. Door op de blauwe 'Start' knop te klikken kunt u beginnen met de prijs- en vragenlijst(en) te beantwoorden. Achter deze knop treft u voor onderhavige aanbesteding de relevante stukken. Definities In dit Offerteverzoek wordt gebruik gemaakt van de definities zoals in de bijlage toegelicht. Definities worden met een hoofdletter beschreven.

title: Netherlands – Programming services of application software – Dataportaal Limburg module catalogus
description: Vanuit de ambitie om datagedreven te werken wil de Provincie Limburg de beschikbaarheid, vindbaarheid en het gebruik van data en informatieproducten optimaal faciliteren, zowel intern als extern. Het Dataportaal Limburg is daarbij de centrale plek waar data en informatieproducten toegankelijk en doorzoekbaar worden aangeboden, volgens het selfserviceprincipe. Het dataportaal is in 2020 gerealiseerd en bestaat uit de modules Catalogus en Basisvisualisaties, die technisch onafhankelijk van elkaar functioneren. De huidige omgeving is gebaseerd op het pakket Dataloket van Analyze by KBenP; zie https://dataportaal.prvlimburg.nl/. Sindsdien heeft de Provincie geïnvesteerd in de ontwikkeling van een modern datafundament. De huidige catalogusmodule sluit onvoldoende aan op dat datafundament, het toevoegen van nieuwe bronnen en connectoren kost relatief veel maatwerk, en de zoekervaring blijft achter bij wat gebruikers van moderne zoekmachines gewend zijn. Samen met de noodzaak de continuïteit van de dienstverlening vanaf 1 januari 2027 te borgen, vormt dat de aanleiding voor deze aanbesteding. De aanleiding, de context en de reikwijdte zijn nader beschreven in Opdrachtomschrijving. De opdracht omvat de levering, implementatie en het beheer van een bestaande, productiewaardige oplossing voor de module catalogus van het Dataportaal Limburg. Het betreft geen ontwikkeltraject: de oplossing kan waar nodig worden geconfigureerd of beperkt aangepast. Tot de opdracht behoren tevens de migratie vanuit de huidige catalogusomgeving, het realiseren van de koppelingen met de provinciale bronsystemen, en het verzorgen van training en handleidingen. De oplossing is de centrale vindplaats voor datasets, informatieproducten, dashboards, services en documenten uit diverse bronsystemen. Gebruikers vinden via één zoekingang zelfstandig wat zij nodig hebben en worden van daaruit doorgeleid naar het bronsysteem. De catalogus is daarmee een vindplaats en geen opslagplaats: metadata blijft zo dicht mogelijk bij de bron. De oplossing is bedoeld voor medewerkers van de Provincie, externe (keten)partners en burgers, waarbij openbare en vertrouwelijke informatie strikt worden gescheiden op basis van dataclassificatie. Het inhoudelijk beheer voert de Provincie zelf uit. De module Basisvisualisaties valt buiten de reikwijdte van deze aanbesteding.

title: Netherlands – Programming services of packaged software products – Statistische representatiesoftware
description: De Provincie Limburg wil medewerkers en externe gebruikers faciliteren in de vindbaarheid en laagdrempelige beschikbaarheid van data. Het Dataportaal Limburg vormt hiervoor de centrale voorziening waarin data vindbaar, toegankelijk en visueel beschikbaar wordt gesteld aan zowel de provinciale organisatie als daarbuiten. Uitgangspunt daarbij is het selfserviceprincipe: gebruikers kunnen zelfstandig relevante data opzoeken, visualiseren en exporteren. Daarnaast biedt het Dataportaal ruimte voor het publiceren en delen van dashboards en monitoringsinformatie ten behoeve van een breed publiek. Deze offerteaanvraag heeft specifiek betrekking op de statistische presentatiesoftware voor de basisvisualisatiemodule binnen het Dataportaal Limburg. Met deze module moeten openbare datasets op een intuïtieve en toegankelijke wijze kunnen worden geraadpleegd, gevisualiseerd, geëxporteerd en beheerd. De Provincie Limburg zoekt een bestaande SaaS-oplossing voor de basisvisualisatiemodule van het Dataportaal Limburg. Deze statistische presentatiesoftware moet gebruikers op een laagdrempelige en intuïtieve manier in staat stellen om zelfstandig data te raadplegen, te visualiseren en te exporteren, overeenkomstig het selfserviceprincipe. De oplossing dient basisvisualisaties te ondersteunen, waaronder tabellen, grafieken, kaarten en andere beschrijvende presentatievormen, en moet daarnaast mogelijkheden bieden voor het opstellen, publiceren en delen van dashboards en monitoringsproducten. Uitgangspunt hierbij is dat de data die in dashboards en monitoring wordt gebruikt, eveneens beschikbaar is binnen de selfserviceomgeving. De oplossing moet tevens voorzien in passende beheerfunctionaliteit, zodat aangewezen informatiespecialisten zelfstandig datasets, configuraties en publicaties kunnen beheren. Momenteel zijn in de bestaande softwareomgeving meer dan 850 statistische indicatoren beschikbaar, die inclusief metadata moeten kunnen worden gemigreerd. Voor een volledige beschrijving van de opdracht en de bijbehorende voorwaarden en eisen die daaraan worden gesteld, wordt verwezen naar het als Bijlage 1 opgenomen Programma van Eisen.
